title: Structured-Data Exercise
prompt: Mark up a product name and availability with appropriate visible content, then outline whether microdata or JSON-LD is being used.
objective: Make the data format explicit and verify the syntax with a current tool.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: microdata, metadata validation.
hints: Structured data must match the actual page content; do not invent ratings, prices, or product facts.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.
